name: front_structural_shell
description: Rounded 2.6 mm shell with integrated mounting reservations; supports, inserts and sealing need detailing.

name: rear_service_shell
description: Rear service closure; recessed screw access and an intentional 0.6 mm seam.

name: lower_impact_wrap
description: Replaceable TPU exterior wrap. Retention and impact performance remain to develop.

name: fixed_sensor_visor
description: Fixed face window; two light apertures and a central camera reservation. No head motor.

name: jump_drive_reservation
description: PROVISIONAL 34 × 74 × 68 mm rotary motor + reduction package. No motor SKU, ratio, torque capacity or internal transmission is established.

name: shared_drive_shaft
description: Shared driven shaft reservation. Each arm attaches through a separate compliant branch, not a rigid cross-axle.

name: battery_reservation
description: Battery reservation only; cell chemistry, current capability, restraint and final dimensions are unselected.

name: control_electronics_reservation
description: Controller, IMU and motor electronics reservation; no PCB design or thermal rating yet.

name: left_covered_arm

name: left_elastic_coupling_reservation

name: left_pivot_trim

name: left_pivot_cap
description: Flush pivot cap; retention not detailed.

name: left_wheel_motor_reservation

name: left_tire

name: left_rim
